entities.summary: Wendy Katrina Justice is a former field hockey player from Scotland, who was a member of the British squad that won the bronze medal at the 1992 Summer Olympics in Barcelona. Affiliated with Glasgow Western Ladies she competed in two consecutive Summer Olympics, starting in 1988 Summer Olympics. She currently coaches the 1XI team at Kelburne Hockey Club.
